niche_preference_profile: This user most often prefers interfaces that feel clean, spacious, and clearly organized, usually with light neutral backgrounds, soft purple accents, subtle card styling, and strong readable hierarchy. They repeatedly favor fewer competing elements, concise copy, labeled actions, and simple section structure. They also like modern, low-framing treatments with flatter presentation and restrained decoration. In a smaller but notable subset of cases, they also respond positively to dark navy, high-emphasis layouts with vivid teal/blue accents, compact density, and stronger CTA prominence.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light neutral or soft gray backgrounds with dark text and subtle purple/pastel accents over darker, harsher, or more saturated themes in most comparisons.
Prefers open spacing, breathing room, and fewer competing elements rather than dense, tightly stacked, or visually crowded layouts.
Prefers screens with obvious sectioning, strong titles/helper text, straightforward grouping, and a single clear focal path rather than busy or weak hierarchy.
Prefers soft, polished cards and controls with subtle borders, rounded corners, low contrast, and lighter visual treatment over heavy outlines or harsh containers.
Prefers CTAs and actions that look active, balanced, and easy to interpret, including text-labeled controls and a clearly emphasized primary action.
Prefers flatter, open presentation with fewer decorative icons, less boxing, less shadow/elevation, and fewer extra visual layers.
Prefers concise copy and easily scannable status/data presentation, such as labeled badges, progress bars, and compact readable summaries over text-heavy or interpretation-heavy displays.
